title: client/objects
description: Game object templates: herb and ore nodes, chests, quest objects, doors.

lock_type.description: LockType id of the object's lock (1 pick lock, 2 herbalism, 3 mining, 5 open, ...), from Lock and LockType.

required_skill_id.description: SkillLine needed to open it: the top-level SkillLine named like the LockType (Herbalism 182, Mining 186). Absent when no SkillLine matches, for example Pick Lock.

required_skill_rank.description: Rank needed in that skill (Lock Skill_k).
